Classification of services - Andhra Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Construction of building for office space - Heading No. 9954 (Construction services) - Applicant has agreed to carry out construction activity namely construction of building for office space/IT space etc. in terms of contract awarded by APIIC, a State Government entity, which is engaged in land acquisition and development and allotment of plots and sheds to various industrial units - Whether since applicant's activity of construction includes both supply of goods and services, applicant's case is covered under Heading No. 9954 as 'construction services' which fall under entry no. (ii) of Sl. No.3 of Notification No. 11/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 and applicable rate of tax is 18% - Held, yes - Whether since applicant does not provide any information or documentary proof that construction of building is for use other than for commerce, industry or any other business or profession, services rendered by it are not eligible for concessional rate of tax - Held, yes [Para 6]GST : Construction of building for office space/IT space etc. by applicant in terms of contract awarded by APIIC, a State Government entity, is covered under Heading No. 9954 as 'construction services'

Classification of services - Madhya Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Construction of residential quarters - Heading No. 9954 (Construction services) - Applicant (M.P. Power Generating Co. Ltd.) is 100 per cent Madhya Pradesh State Government hold company - State Government of Madhya Pradesh awarded a contract to applicant to construct a Thermal Power Project - Further applicant awarded a contract to one 'S' towards construction of certain residential quarters at Thermal Power Project - Whether work contract awarded by applicant to 'S' for construction of residential quarters at Thermal Power Project shall attract GST at rate of 18 per cent (9 per cent CGST + 9 per cent SGST) under Heading No. 9954 - Held, yes [Para 8.1][In favour of revenue]GST: Where State Government of Madhya Pradesh awarded a contract to applicant, a 100 per cent State Government hold company, to construct a Thermal Power Project and further applicant awarded a contract to one 'S' towards construction of certain residential quarters at Thermal Power Project, work contract awarded by applicant to 'S' for construction of residential quarters shall attract GST at rate of 18 per cent under Heading No. 9954

Construction service - Composite supply of Works contracts - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate - Applicant is awarded construction services contract by Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd (APIIC) deriving its sustenance from sale of sheds, land, houses on outright sale or hire purchase - 100% of APIIC shares held by Andhra Pradesh Government and its nominees - HELD: APIIC is 'Government Entity' for GST matters as defined in para 4 of clauses (ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by  Notification No. 31/2017-CT (Rate) dated 13-10-2017 - However, APIIC runs on business model as it would pass on costs in its transactions to end client, and its activities and modus operandi are basically business and not otherwise - As construction is for APIIC's use to conduct its essentially business oriented activities, applicant's contract is not eligible for concessional rate of 12% under SI.No.3 (vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Applicant's contract is classifiable under SAC heading No. 9954 under Construction Services, with entry Sr. No. 3(ii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 i.e., Composite Supply of works contract as defined in section 2 (119) of CGST Act, 2017 and applicant is liable to 18 per cent rate of tax [Section 2(9) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Andhra Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 7] [In favour of revenue]   Circulars and Notifications : Notification No. 11/2017-C.T. (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, Notification No. 24/2017-C.T. (Rate), dated 21-9-2017, Notification No. 17/2018-C.T. (Rate), dated 26-7-2018,  Notification No. 31/2017-C.T. (Rate), dated 13-10-2017

Emoluments paid to staff - Other employment and labour supply services nowhere else classified - Heading No. 998519 - Classification - Tax Liability - Applicant is authority created under Airports Authority of India Act, 1994 - Applicant entered into a concessionaire agreement with Adani Thiruvananthapuram International Airport Limited - Applicant seeks advance ruling on whether GST is leviable on invoice raised by applicant staff cost salary/of reimbursement Thiruvananthapuram International Airport Limited? If yes, at what rate? - Held: From clause 6.5.5 of agreement, impugned amount represents 'emoluments' payable by applicant to select employees, i.e., employees of applicant working for concessionaire - In this regard, employees of applicant are supplied to concessionaire for a consideration, in pursuant to agreement - Hence, this service falls under 'Other employment and labour supply services nowhere else classified' viz. HSN 998519 - Applicable tax rate for this SAC is 9 per cent each towards CGST and SGST as applicable vide Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017. [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 8] [Against assessee]

Construction service - Tax liability - Rate - Sale of semi-finished structure and supply of completion of semi-finished structure - HELD: Agreements entered with prospective buyers separately for sale of semi-finished structure and supply of service of completion of semi-finished structure by way of providing construction service will be considered as non-severable agreement or single contract - GST at rate of 1 per cent and 5 per cent will be levied on affordable housing and other housing respectively without ITC - If contract is severable from initial agreement, then GST at rate of 18 per cent will be levied for such construction service [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Telangana Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 7] [In favour of assessee]

Classification of services - Gujarat Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (Construction services) - Heading No. 9954 (Construction services) - Applicant is engaged in development and construction of residential and commercial complex, called 'SAMANVAY RESIDENCY' - Development Authority has approved 'Samnvay Residency' under 'Affordable Housing Project' - Whether since project undertaken by applicant falls under definition of 'Affordable Housing', applicant's case is covered under reduced tax rate of 12 per cent GST - Held, yes [Paras 18-22]GST : Where applicant is engaged in development of residential project called 'SAMANVAY RESIDENCY', which falls under affordable housing project, construction services provided by applicant qualifies for reduced tax rate of 12 per cent GST as provided in Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017-C.T. (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

Government Housing Scheme - Construction services -  Composite supply of work contract - Heading No. 9954 -Applicant-assessee is engaged in construction services - It has undertaken works contract tendered by Rajasthan Housing Board under scheme of Chief Minister Jan Awas Yojna 2015 programme having nexus with 'Housing for all' initiative under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojna of Government of India - HELD: As per Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022, GST rates of works contract involving construction, erection, commissioning, installation, completion, fitting out, repair, maintenance, renovation, or alteration rendered to Government or Local authority is increased to 18 per cent - In light of Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022, services provided by applicant to RHB will attract a rate of 18 per cent GST after 13-7-2022 onward until rate is not changed [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Rajasthan Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 6 and 7] [In favour of assessee]GST : Where applicant, engaged in providing construction services, undertook work contract tendered by Rajasthan Housing Board under scheme of Chief Minister Jan Awas Yojna 2015, services provided by assessee will attract a rate of 18 per cent GST as per Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022

Classification of services - Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Construction of independent houses under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Heading No. 9954 [Construction Services] - Applicant has entered into a sub-contract agreement for execution of works contract pertaining to construction of independent houses under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana with main contractor, who has been awarded contract - Whether sub-contract of construction of independent houses by applicant under main contract of construction of houses pertaining to Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana is covered under sub-item (c) of item (iv) of Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 and liable to CGST at 6 per cent + SGST at 6 per cent - Held, yes [Para 6] [In favour of assessee]GST : Where applicant has entered into a sub-contract agreement for execution of works contract pertaining to construction of independent houses under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana with main contractor, who has been awarded contract, sub-contract is covered under sub-item (c) of item (iv) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 and liable to CGST at 6 per cent + SGST at 6 per cent

Government Housing Scheme - Construction services -  Composite supply of work contract - Heading No. 9954 -Applicant-assessee is engaged in construction services - It has undertaken works contract tendered by Rajasthan Housing Board under scheme of Chief Minister Jan Awas Yojna 2015 programme having nexus with 'Housing for all' initiative under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojna of Government of India - HELD: As per Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022, GST rates of works contract involving construction, erection, commissioning, installation, completion, fitting out, repair, maintenance, renovation, or alteration rendered to Government or Local authority is increased to 18 per cent - In light of Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022, services provided by applicant to RHB will attract a rate of 18 per cent GST after 13-7-2022 onward until rate is not changed [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Rajasthan Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 6 and 7] [In favour of assessee]   Circulars and Notifications: Notification No. 3/2022- Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022.

Works contract - Construction service - Heading No 9954 - Concessional rate - Applicant enters into contract for construction of hostel and various buildings for IIT as sub-contractor of principal contractor who has procured work - Whether impugned supply is covered under Sl. No. 3(ix) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) to be eligible for concessional GST rate of 12 per cent - HELD : IIT being an educational institution, service of construction of structure provided to it can be considered as construction of structure meant predominantly for use as an educational establishment and not for commerce, industry or any other business or profession - IIT is government entity as it is registered as a society and it is established by Government - Scope of work as per agreement and duties of IIT under relevant statute reveal that impugned services procured are in relation to work entrusted by Central Government and thus, eligible for concessional rate of GST at 12 per cent - Sl. No. 3(ix) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) [Section 2(119) and 11 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Odisha Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 4.4, 4.5, 4.9 to 4.11] [In favour of assessee]GST : Service of construction of structure for IIT is eligible for concessional GST rate at 12 per cent as the structure is meant predominantly for use as an educational establishment and recipient is a government entity  GST : Concessional rate of 12 per cent GST is applicable from the date when Notification No. 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate) has come into effect or from commencement date of contract whichever is earlier

Construction service - Affordable residential apartment - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate - Residential Real Estate Project (RREP) comprised of both affordable and other than affordable residential apartments - HELD : Project undertaken is covered under definition of 'real estate project' and applicant falls within definition of a 'promoter' - Construction of affordable residential apartments is covered under services specified in entry at Sl. No. 3(i) and (ia) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) - GST is payable at 1.5 per cent in respect of service of construction of affordable residential apartments and at 7.5 per cent in respect of service of construction of residential apartments other than affordable residential apartments [Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.7 and 7.8] [In favour of assessee]   Circulars  Notifications : Notification No. 3/2019-Central Tax (Rate), dated 29-3-2019 and Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

Construction service - Composite supply of Works contracts - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate - Applicant is awarded construction services contract by Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd (APIIC) deriving its sustenance from sale of sheds, land, houses on outright sale or hire purchase - 100% of APIIC shares held by Andhra Pradesh Government and its nominees - HELD: APIIC is 'Government Entity' for GST matters as defined in para 4 of clauses (ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by  Notification No. 31/2017-CT (Rate) dated 13-10-2017 - However, APIIC runs on business model as it would pass on costs in its transactions to end client, and its activities and modus operandi are basically business and not otherwise - As construction is for APIIC's use to conduct its essentially business oriented activities, applicant's contract is not eligible for concessional rate of 12% under SI.No.3 (vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Applicant's contract is classifiable under SAC heading No. 9954 under Construction Services, with entry Sr. No. 3(ii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 i.e., Composite Supply of works contract as defined in section 2 (119) of CGST Act, 2017 and applicant is liable to 18 per cent rate of tax [Section 2(9) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Andhra Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 7] [In favour of revenue]GST : Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd (APIIC), whose 100% shares are held by Andhra Pradesh Government, is 'Government Entity' for GST matters; however, APIIC's activities being essentially business oriented and it passes its transaction costs to its end clients, applicant who is awarded construction contract by APIIC is not eligible for 12% concessional rate; it will be liable to 18% GST

Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - State Police Housing and Infrastructure Corporation is a company of Government of Karnataka State incorporated under companies Act, 1956 and all shares are held by Government of Karnataka; hence, it qualifies to be considered as a government entity-Works contract services executed for construction of high security prison are liable to GST at 18 per cent with effect from 1-1-2022 as per entry No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended vide Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021 and Notification No. 03/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.1 and 14] [In favour of revenue] Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Kudala Sangama Development Board was established under Kudala Sangama Development Board Act, 1994 - More than 90 per cent of members of board are from State Government and all administrative expenses of board are covered by grants given by State Government; hence, it qualifies to be considered as a Government Entity - Works contract services executed for construction of International Center and Museum are liable to GST at 18 per cent with effect from 1-1-2022 as per entry No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended vide Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021 and Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.2 and 14] [In favour of revenue] Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Karnataka Residential Educational Institutions Society (KRIES) is formed under societies Registration Act and Government of Karnataka may appoint persons to review progress of society and to hold inquiries into affairs of society and give directions; hence, qualifies to be considered as a Government Entity - Works contract services executed for Construction of Residential school complex are liable to GST at 18 per cent with effect from 1-1-2022 as per Entry No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended vide Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021 and Notification No. 03/2022 - Central Tax (Rate), dated : 13-7-2022 [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.3 and 14] [In favour of revenue] Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Works of construction of Airport Terminal Buildings/facilities and associated works awarded by Public Works Department of Government of Karnataka, are work supplied to State Government – However, said works for construction of airport terminal building or airport are predominantly meant for commerce and, hence, are not covered under Entry 3(iii),(vi),(ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Said works are covered under entry 3(xii) liable to 18 per cent tax [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.4 and 14] [In favour of revenue]   Circulars and Notifications : Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017; Notification No. 15/2021 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 18-11-2021; Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021; and Notification No. 03/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022

Classification of services - Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Civil construction services - Heading No. 9954 (Construction services) - Applicant-company is engaged in business of civil construction of residential premises as a contractor - It seeks advance ruling on issue as to whether construction services proposed to be provided by applicant will qualify for reduced GST rate of 12 per cent as provided in Sr. No. 3, item (v)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 1/2018-Central tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018 - Low cost houses in an affordable housing project having area of 60 sq. mts. or upto 60 sq. mts. will attract 12 per cent GST - Whether since project undertaken by applicant is an affordable housing project, it will attract rate of 12 per cent GST under Sr. No. 3 of said Notification – Held, yes [Para 5.8][In favour of assessee]GST: Where applicant undertook project of construction of residential flat (Low cost flats) having carpet area of upto or less than 60 sq. mts. and its project falls under definition of 'Affordable Housing Project', applicant's case is covered under concessional tax rate slab of 12 per cent

Slum infrastructure - Construction service - Works contract service for State Slum Development Board - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Construction of houses and infrastructure in slums for Karnataka Slum Development Board under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana as a main contractor are liable to 12 per cent GST till 17-7-2022, in terms of Sl. No. 3(iv)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification Nos. 20/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 22-8-2017 and 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018 and thereafter, such services are liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of said Notification as amended by Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 - Such services when rendered as a sub-contractor, are not covered under Sl. No. 3(ix) and liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of said Notification [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10 to 12 and 16 to 18]  Housing construction - Construction service - Works contract service for State Housing Board - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Construction services are provided to Karnataka Housing Board with respect to construction of Police Station as a main contractor/sub-contractor - Karnataka Housing Board having been established under Karnataka Housing Board Act, 1962 and carrying out functions entrusted by State Government is to be considered as Government Entity as defined under Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 31/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017 and liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 13, 14 and 16 to 18]  Market construction - Construction service - Works contract service for Government SPV - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Construction services are provided to Belagavi Smart City Limited, a Special Purpose Vehicle company incorporated by Government of Karnataka and Belagavi City Corporation on 50:50 shareholding basis, as a main contractor/sub-contractor for development of modern market under a smart city project - Said company neither being a Governmental Authority nor a Government Entity as defined under Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification No. 31/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017, construction services provided to it with respect to development of modern market is liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 irrespective of whether such services provided as a main contractor or sub-contractor [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 15 to 18]   Circulars and Notifications : Notification No. 20/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 22-8-2017; Notification No. 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018; Notification No. 15/2021-Central Tax (Rate), dated 18-11-2021; Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017; Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 and Notification No. 31/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-10-2017

Classification of services - Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Housing Project construction -  Heading 9954 - [Construction services] - Applicant has entered into civil construction contract with 'J' Ltd. in respect of seven residential buildings - Whether since project undertaken by applicant falls under definition of 'Affordable Housing Project' (carpet area being less than 60 sq. Mts.) applicant's case is covered under concessional tax rate of 12 per cent under Heading No. 9954 (Construction services) in terms of item (v)(da) of Sr. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017, Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 - Held, yes - Whether, therefore, benefit of reduced rate would be available to applicant in cases of supply effected after 25-1-2018, i.e. date on which Notification 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate) was issued for those flats having carpet area upto 60 sq. mtrs. - Held, yes - Whether, however, in case of other flats which have carpet area more than 60 sq. mtrs. or which are commercial units, applicant would be required to pay GST at normal applicable rate - Held, yes - Whether building completion and finishing services will not be regarded as a separate services; such building completion and finishing services will be a part of composite supply of works contract services with principal supply of building construction - Held,yes - Whether 'housing project' cannot be confined only to dwelling units, it would also include within its fold, other common amenities, structures, etc. and, thus, rate applicable to principal supply will also be applicable to common amenities - Held, yes - Whether rate of GST will be 18% on works contract services provided for construction of units, common areas and amenities which do not qualify criteria of low cost houses - Held, yes [Paras 5.11, and 5.14.2][In favour of assessee]GST : Where applicant constructs residential complex under contract and project undertaken by it falls under definition of ‘affordable housing project’ (carpet area being less than 60 sq. Mts.), applicant’s case is covered under Heading No. 9954 eligible for concessional tax rate of 12 per cent; in case of other flats which have carpet area more than 60 sq. mtrs. or which are commercial units, applicant would be required to pay GST at normal applicable rate

RBF shed construction - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate - Construction services is being provided by applicant to Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd. (APIIC) - APIIC is getting revenue from operations like sale of land, houses, interest on hire purchase, long-term borrowings etc. - In APIIC, Andhra Pradesh Government and its nominees have 100 per cent shareholding, hence, it is "Government entity" as defined in para 4 of clauses (ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - APIIC derives its sustenance from sale of sheds, land, houses on outright sale or hire purchase etc. - APIIC runs on business model as it would pass costs in its transactions to end client - APIIC's activities are essentially business oriented - Hence, construction services provided by applicant to APIIC are not eligible for concessional rate of 12 per cent available under Notification No. 24/2017-CT (Rate), dated 21-9-2017 - Applicant's contract with APIIC is classifiable under Heading No. 9954 under construction services, with Entry No. (ii) of Sr. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 i.e., Composite Supply of Works Contract as defined in section 2(119) of CGST Act 2017 and APGST Act, 2017, and liable to 18 per cent (9 per cent CGST and 9 per cent SGST) [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Andhra Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 7] [In favour of revenue]   Circulars and Notifications :  Notification No. 11/2017-C.T. (Rate), dated 28-6-2017    Notification No. 24/2017-C.T. (Rate), dated 21-9-2017    Notification No. 17/2018-C.T. (Rate), dated 26-7-2018    Notification No. 31/2017-C.T. (Rate), dated 13-10-2017

Construction service - Works contract service - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Whether composite supply of works contract service to Road and Building Department is covered under entry at Sl. Nos. 3(vi)(a) and (b) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate) with applicable GST rate being 12 per cent - HELD : Impugned supply is in nature of composite supply of works contract service as it includes construction of school building, school and college hostels etc. - Impugned service is supplied to Gujarat Government - Activity undertaken is outside purview of business - School building is meant for use as an educational establishment as described in entry at Sl. No. 3(vi)(b)(i) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT(R) - Supply of staff quarters is covered under entry at Sl. No. 3(vi)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT(R) - School building will be used by State Government for education and cannot be considered as commercial building - Impugned supply merits classification under entry at Sl. No. 3(vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT(R) attracting 12 per cent GST [Gujarat Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 9, 10 and 11] [In favour of assessee]GST : Composite supply of works contract that includes construction of school building, school and college hostel, staff quarters, etc. provided to State Government is subject to 12% GST as it is covered under entry at Sl. No. 3(vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate)

Works contract service - Construction of employee quarters - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Whether execution of works contract service for construction of residential quarters for employees of Kudankulam Nuclear Power Project (KKNPP) which is unit of Nuclear Power Corporation India Limited (NPCIL) would be taxable at 12 per cent - HELD : Works contract service is provided as is evident from contract - NPCIL qualifies as government entity as it has been established under Department of Atomic Energy with 100 per cent equity held by Central Government - Work entrusted to NPCIL is to implement atomic power projects for generation of electricity - Construction of residential quarters for KKNPP cannot be construed as work in relation to work entrusted to NPCIL by Central Government in absence of any document providing for same - Impugned works contract service is not covered under entry at Sl. No. 3(vi) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT(R) and concessional rate of 12 per cent is not available - GST is payable at 18 per cent in terms of entry at Sl. No. 3(xii) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT(R) - Concessional rate of 12 per cent will not be available even if service rendered is in relation to work entrusted by government entity as said term was omitted from 1-1-2022 [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Tamil Nadu Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, 8 and 10] [In favour of revenue]GST : Concessional rate of 12 per cent GST is not available to works contract service rendered to government entity when same is not in relation to work entrusted by government till 31-12-2021 and even otherwise after 1-1-2022 such activity is liable to GST of 18 per cent  GST : Advance ruling cannot be sought on questions that are purely procedural in nature

Classification of services - Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Construction service provided to National Centre for Biological Sciences - Heading No. 9954 [Construction services] - Applicant has entered into a works contract agreement with National Centre for Biological Sciences [NCBS] for purpose of execution of works contract for construction of building at NCBS Campus - NCBS is not Central Government, State Government, Union Territory, a local authority, a Governmental Authority or a Government Entity - Whether service supplied by applicant to NCBS is covered under item (xii) of Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 and taxable at 9 per cent CGST and 9 per cent SGST - Held, yes [Para 6] [In favour of revenue]GST : Where applicant has entered into a works contract agreement with National Centre for Biological Sciences [NCBS] for purpose of execution of works contract for construction of building at NCBS Campus, service supplied by applicant to NCBS is covered under item (xii) of Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 and taxable at 9 per cent CGST and 9 per cent SGST

Construction of residential apartments in a Residential Real Estate Project - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Applicant has acquired a piece of land and developed same into a layout - It has entered into MoU with prospective buyers for purchase of land and construction of residential house - Two separate agreements with buyer is entered, one for sale of plot (sale deed) and other for construction of residential house - Signing of MoU and execution of two agreements on same day implies that construction service provided by applicant to buyers is a single contract for sale of land and construction of building - HELD : Activity rendered by applicant is in nature of 'original works' since applicant is constructing a new building - Project being undertaken by applicant is a residential real estate project (RREP) as no commercial apartments are constructed in project - Activity of applicant would fall under Entry No. 3(i) and 3(ii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) and conditions mentioned should be strictly adhered to for claiming benefit of said Notification - Applicant is eligible to claim Entry No. 3(i) and 3(ii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) as amended by Notification No. 3/2019-Central Tax (Rate) and liable to pay GST at rate of 1.5 per cent in respect of construction of affordable residential apartments and at rate of 7.5 per cent for construction of apartments other than affordable residential apartments - Further, taxable value for Construction services supplied by applicant is governed by provisions of Para 2 of Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate) r/ w Notification No. 11/2017-ST (Rate) as amended - Accordingly, applicant is eligible to avail only deduction of one-third of total amount charged for supply for arriving at taxable value of supply [Section 9, read with section 11, of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Tamil Nadu Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 23][In favour of Revenue]  Circulars and Notifications: Circular DOF No. 334/1/12010-TRU dated 26-022010, TRU's letter F. No. 354/32/2019-TRU dated 7th May, 2019, Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate) r/w Notification No. 11/2017-ST(Rate)

Residential apartment construction - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional Rate - Applicant-real estate developer has purchased land in its name and has obtained building permit - It has entered into two agreements with customers; one for sale of undivided share of land and another for construction of apartment - GST is not collected on amount collected for undivided share of land but same was collected for apartment construction at rate of 18 per cent - Applicant's project is satisfying all conditions of definition of 'ongoing project' as occurring in clause (xx) of Para 4 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended by Notification No. 3/2019-Central Tax (Rate), dated 29-3-2019 - Applicant is eligible and has exercised its option for continuing with payment of tax at old rates in respect of ongoing projects - Project is not covered under any of schemes specified under Item (ie) of Sl. No. 3 of said notification - Therefore, applicant is not eligible for concessional rate of tax at 12 per cent - Applicant is liable to pay GST at rate of 18 per cent in respect of services of construction of residential apartments supplied by it [Kerala Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.10] [In favour of revenue]GST : Applicant-real estate developer having exercised its option for continuing with payment of tax at old rates in respect to its ongoing project of construction of residential apartments should pay GST at rate of 18 per cent; since project is not covered under any of schemes specified under Item (ie) of Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), applicant is not eligible for concessional rate of tax of 12 per cent  GST : Where applicant is providing construction of residential apartment services alongwith sale of an undivided share of land in arriving at taxable value of supply, applicant will be eligible to avail deduction of one-third of total amount (being deemed value of undivided share of land) charged for supply   GST : Provisions of section 13 of CGST, 2017 will apply to determination of time of supply of construction of residential apartments services

Slum infrastructure - Construction service - Works contract service for State Slum Development Board - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Construction of houses and infrastructure in slums for Karnataka Slum Development Board under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana as a main contractor are liable to 12 per cent GST till 17-7-2022, in terms of Sl. No. 3(iv)(c) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification Nos. 20/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 22-8-2017 and 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018 and thereafter, such services are liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of said Notification as amended by Notification No. 3/2022-Central Tax (Rate), dated 13-7-2022 - Such services when rendered as a sub-contractor, are not covered under Sl. No. 3(ix) and liable to 18 per cent GST in terms of Sl. No. 3(xii) of said Notification [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10 to 12 and 16 to 18]GST : Construction of houses and infrastructure in slums for State Slum Development Board under Government Scheme as a main contractor is liable to 12 per cent GST till 17-7-2022 and thereafter, to 18 per cent GST; however, these services when provided by sub-contractor are also liable to 18 per cent GST  GST : Construction services provided to State Housing Board with respect to construction of Police Station as a main contractor/sub-contractor are liable to 18 per cent GST  GST : Construction services provided to a SPV of State Government and Municipal Corporation, for development of market under smart city project are liable to 18 per cent GST irrespective of whether such services are provided by main contractor or sub-contractor

Construction service - Affordable residential apartment - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate - Residential Real Estate Project (RREP) comprised of both affordable and other than affordable residential apartments - HELD : Project undertaken is covered under definition of 'real estate project' and applicant falls within definition of a 'promoter' - Construction of affordable residential apartments is covered under services specified in entry at Sl. No. 3(i) and (ia) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) - GST is payable at 1.5 per cent in respect of service of construction of affordable residential apartments and at 7.5 per cent in respect of service of construction of residential apartments other than affordable residential apartments [Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.7 and 7.8] [In favour of assessee]GST : Where Residential Real Estate Project (RREP) comprised of both affordable and other than affordable residential apartments, GST is payable at 1.5 per cent in respect of service of construction of affordable residential apartments and at 7.5 per cent in respect of construction of apartments other than affordable apartments

RBF shed construction - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 - Concessional rate - Construction services is being provided by applicant to Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Ltd. (APIIC) - APIIC is getting revenue from operations like sale of land, houses, interest on hire purchase, long-term borrowings etc. - In APIIC, Andhra Pradesh Government and its nominees have 100 per cent shareholding, hence, it is "Government entity" as defined in para 4 of clauses (ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - APIIC derives its sustenance from sale of sheds, land, houses on outright sale or hire purchase etc. - APIIC runs on business model as it would pass costs in its transactions to end client - APIIC's activities are essentially business oriented - Hence, construction services provided by applicant to APIIC are not eligible for concessional rate of 12 per cent available under Notification No. 24/2017-CT (Rate), dated 21-9-2017 - Applicant's contract with APIIC is classifiable under Heading No. 9954 under construction services, with Entry No. (ii) of Sr. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 i.e., Composite Supply of Works Contract as defined in section 2(119) of CGST Act 2017 and APGST Act, 2017, and liable to 18 per cent (9 per cent CGST and 9 per cent SGST) [Section 2(119) of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Andhra Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 7] [In favour of revenue]GST : Even though APIIC is a Government entity, since its activities are essentially business oriented, RBF shed construction services as provided by applicant to APIIC are not eligible for concessional rate of 12 per cent GST; applicant's service would be classifiable under heading No. 9954; it is Composite Supply of Works Contract liable to 18 per cent GST

Works contract services - Government entity - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Works of construction of Airport Terminal Buildings/facilities and associated works awarded by Public Works Department of Government of Karnataka, are work supplied to State Government – However, said works for construction of airport terminal building or airport are predominantly meant for commerce and, hence, are not covered under Entry 3(iii),(vi),(ix) and (x) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Said works are covered under entry 3(xii) liable to 18 per cent tax [Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 10.4 and 14] [In favour of revenue]

Hotel -cum-shopping and multiplex construction - Construction Services - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Applicant intends to get a land from WBHIDCO on 99 years lease for purpose of setting up of hotel-cum-shopping and multiplex which includes permission to construct certain area as residential flats - According to Draft Lease Deed as per tender, lessee is not permitted to sub-lease land or part thereof - However, applicant, being lessee, will be permitted to sub-lease/ assign right on constructed area - It is obvious that ownership of land remains with WBHIDCO - Applicant may sub-lease/assign rights of constructed area in following two models (a) one-time lump sum payment (may be payable in installments till completion and granting possession and registry in favour of prospective clients) for constructed units, (b) against periodic payments for use constructed area, during term of agreement, without any registry with Registrar and on expiry constructed area shall be repossessed by lessee i.e. applicant - HELD: Applicable SAC Code on this supply is 9954 as Construction Services) and applicable tax rate on supply under consideration shall be 18% - Applicant is eligible for a deduction as attributable to land portion i.e. 1/3 of consideration on total value of supply for purpose of payment of applicable tax - GST is to be paid on construction work for prospective clients, regardless of whether a lump sum or periodic payments, is charged [Section  9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/ West Bengal Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 3.9, 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12] [In favour of Revenue]GST : Where applicant gets a land on 99 years lease, sets up hotel-cum-shopping and multiplex and sub-leases constructed area, applicable SAC Code on this supply is 9954 (Construction Services) and applicable tax rate on supply under consideration shall be 18%  GST: Where applicant gets a land on 99 years lease, sets up hotel-cum-shopping and multiplex and sub-leases constructed area, such service will not fall under Accommodation Service (SAC: 9963) and, hence, question of exemption under entry in sl. No. 12 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) will not arise  GST: Where applicant gets a land on 99 years lease, sets up hotel-cum-shopping and multiplex and sub-leases constructed area, monthly/annual maintenance charges will be liable to GST as per sl. no. 33 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate); SAC Code would be 9995 and applicable GST rate is 18%

Pure labour service - Construction service - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Applicant entered into an agreement with M/s B.C.M. Builders LLP to provide pure labour construction services - M/s B.C.M. Builders LLP has entered into a contract with Rajasthan Government to construct 380 flats under 'Affordable Housing Scheme under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana' (including material and labour) - M/s B.C.M. Builders LLP has further sublet work to applicant - HELD : As per Entry No. 10 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate), following main requirements to get the benefit of the above notification - (a) Services provided by way of pure labour contracts and (b) Applicable only to the beneficiary-led individual house construction or enhancement under the Housing for All (Urban) Mission or Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - As applicant is under obligation to provide machine and other material besides labour supply, agreement between applicant and M/s B.C.M. Builders LLP is not a pure labour contract service supplied for construction of 380 flats under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Further, benefit of relevant entry of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 is applicable only to beneficiary-led individual house construction or enhancement under Housing for All (Urban) Mission or Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Applicant could not establish that they are working for Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Therefore, service provided by applicant for construction of flats is not covered under Entry No. 10 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 (as amended) - Construction service provided by applicant falls under HSN code 9954 attracting GST at rate of 18 per cent [Section  9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/ Rajasthan Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 8 to 11] [In favour of revenue]

Construction of cultural complex - Construction Services - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Applicant provides works contract services of supply of materials, and labour for executing works - Assessee entered into agreement with State film development corporation for development and construction of cultural complex - HELD : State film development corporation is a public sector undertaking established by government of Kerala for promotion of Malyalam cinema in state - It falls under definition of 'government authority' as is fully under control of Government of Kerala and established for purpose listed under Sl. No. 21 of eleventh schedule of constitution - Furthermore, works contract services are performed by applicant as per contracts awarded by State film development corporation to construct a cultural complex is in nature of construction of structure meant for predominantly use as a cultural establishment and is liable to GST at 12 per cent as per Sl. 3(vi)(b) of Notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Paras 7.16 and 7.19] [In favour of assessee]   Circulars and Notifications : Sl 3(vi)(b) of Notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, Notification No. 24/2017- Central Tax (Rate), Dated 21-9-2017, Notification No. 31/2017 CT (Rate), dated 13-10-2017, Notification No. 46/2017 CT (Rate), dated 14-11-2017, Notification No. 17/2018 CT (Rate), dated 26-7-2018, Notification No. 03/2019 CT (Rate), dated 29-3-2019, Notification No. 22/2021- Central Tax (Rate), dated 31-12-2021 and Notification No. 08/2017- Integrated Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

Classification of services - Odisha Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 (Construction services) - Section 2(119) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Section 2(119) of the Odisha Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Works contract - Applicant-contractor has been awarded a contract by NBCC for construction of ISPAT Post Graduate Medical Institute and Super Speciality Hospital at Rourkela Steel Plant for SAIL in Odisha on Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) basis - Scope of work includes construction of medical institute and super speciality hospital and such work would certainly come under construction of clinical establishment and gets classified under SI. No. 3(vi)(a) or (b) and (ix) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 which provides for construction of a structure meant predominantly for use as a clinical establishment - Whether instant supply is a 'composite supply of works contract service' provided or to be provided in relation to construction of civil structure meant predominantly for use as a clinical establishment - Held, yes - Whether since supply is being made to NBCC which is a body corporate and not to any Government or Government entity, pre-requisite to merit classification under SI. No. 3(vi)(a) or (b) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 is not fulfilled - Held, yes - Whether since composite supply of works contract services have been entrusted by Central Government, supply of works contract service would merit entitlement for concessional rate of GST at rate of 12 per cent [CGST at rate of 6 per cent + SGST at rate of 6 per cent] in terms of SI. No. 3(ix) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Held, yes [Paras 4.5 to 4.12]GST : Where applicant has been awarded a contract by NBCC for construction of ISPAT Post Graduate Medical Institute and Super Speciality Hospital for SAIL in Odisha on Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) basis, instant supply is a 'Composite Supply of works contract service' provided in relation to construction of civil structure meant pre-dominantly for use as a clinical establishment; since supply is being made to NBCC which is a body corporate and not to any Government or Government entity, pre-requisite to merit classification under SI. No. 3(vi)(a) or (b) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 is not fulfilled; since composite supply of works contract services have been entrusted by Central Government, supply of works contract service would merit entitlement for concessional rate of GST at rate of 12 per cent [CGST at rate of 6 per cent + SGST at rate of 6 per cent] in terms of SI. No. 3(ix) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

Fire-fighting installation with pump house -  Construction of a complex, building, civil structure or a part thereof, including a complex or building intended for sale to a buyer, wholly or partly - Heading No. 9954 - Exemption - Appellant-assessee is a partnership firm and a civil contractor engaged in construction of roads, buildings, civil structures or various other civil works as awarded from various Governmental and non-Governmental organizations - AAR has held that appellant, is liable to pay GST at rate 18 per cent - What will be GST rate for work undertaken by appellant for service recipient under bid - HELD : It is observed that services provided by appellant are covered under Item number (vi) in Column (3) of Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 as amended - Therefore, said services are liable to attract GST at 12 per cent (i.e. 6 per cent CGST and 6 per cent SGST) during contracted period only up to 31-12-2021, as after that, in Column No. (3) of Sl. No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 words 'Governmental authority or a Government entity' has been omitted vide Notification No. 22/2021-Central Tax(Rate), dated 31-12-2021 with effect from 1-1-2022 [Section 11 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Rajasthan Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para11] [Partly in favour of assessee]

Classification of services - Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 [Construction services] - Section 2(119) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Section 2(119) of the Kerala State Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Works contract - A charitable organisation 'S' engaged in various charitable activities across Kerala has awarded a rehabilitation project to applicant for providing affordable shelter to 2018 flood victims - Applicant constructed 45 residential units in different locations on land belonging to flood victims identified by Trust - Whether activity undertaken by applicant cannot be construed as construction of affordable residential apartments by a promoter in a residential real estate project intended for sale to a buyer and, hence, rate of GST prescribed under Sl. No. 3(i) of Notification No. 11/2017 Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, is not applicable in respect of said activity - Held, yes - Whether activity undertaken by applicant is construction of 45 individual residential houses at different locations on land belonging to individual beneficiaries and activity squarely falls within scope of works contract as defined in section 2(119) - Held, yes - Whether services provided by applicant to 'S' for construction of low cost housing units falls within ambit of Sl. No. 3(v) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 and is liable to GST at rate of 12 per cent - Held, yes [Paras 11 and 15]GST : Where applicant constructed residential units on land belonging to flood victims under a rehabilitation project awarded to it by a charitable trust, activity squarely falls within scope of works contract under section 2(119) and is liable to GST at rate of 12 per cent as per Sl. No. 3(v) of Notification No. 11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

Construction of residential apartments in a Residential Real Estate Project - Construction services - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Applicant has acquired a piece of land and developed same into a layout - It has entered into MoU with prospective buyers for purchase of land and construction of residential house - Two separate agreements with buyer is entered, one for sale of plot (sale deed) and other for construction of residential house - Signing of MoU and execution of two agreements on same day implies that construction service provided by applicant to buyers is a single contract for sale of land and construction of building - HELD : Activity rendered by applicant is in nature of 'original works' since applicant is constructing a new building - Project being undertaken by applicant is a residential real estate project (RREP) as no commercial apartments are constructed in project - Activity of applicant would fall under Entry No. 3(i) and 3(ii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) and conditions mentioned should be strictly adhered to for claiming benefit of said Notification - Applicant is eligible to claim Entry No. 3(i) and 3(ii) of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) as amended by Notification No. 3/2019-Central Tax (Rate) and liable to pay GST at rate of 1.5 per cent in respect of construction of affordable residential apartments and at rate of 7.5 per cent for construction of apartments other than affordable residential apartments - Further, taxable value for Construction services supplied by applicant is governed by provisions of Para 2 of Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate) r/ w Notification No. 11/2017-ST (Rate) as amended - Accordingly, applicant is eligible to avail only deduction of one-third of total amount charged for supply for arriving at taxable value of supply [Section 9, read with section 11, of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Tamil Nadu Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 23][In favour of Revenue]GST : Where a residential project developer sells plots and simultaneously enters into agreement for construction of residential houses with buyers, transaction constitutes a single composite contract of land sale and construction of building qualifying as ‘original works’ in an RREP, taxable under Entry 3(i)/(ii) of Notification No. 11/2017-CT (Rate) at 1.5% for affordable and 7.5% for other residential apartments.

Classification of services - Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Works contract - Heading No. 9954 [Construction Services] - Applicant a Private Limited Company entered into a works contract agreement with National Centre for Biological Sciences(NCBS) for construction of Hostel building at NCBS Campus in Bangalore - It sought advance ruling on whether it should charge GST at rate of 12 per cent for service provided to NCBS as per Notification No 24/2017 Central Tax (Rate) dated 21-9-2017- It is found that NCBS, which is a separate centre of Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), receives grant from Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India and that NCBS is neither set-up by an Act of Parliament or State Legislature nor was established by any Government, but is an autonomous body under aegis of TIFR - Moreover, council administering this institute has only 4 members appointed by Government and therefore Government does not have more than 90 per cent control over it - Thus, NCBS is not covered under definition of a 'Government Entity' as per clause (x) of para 4 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax(Rate) dated 28-6-2017 - Furthermore, Institute is not established to carry out a function entrusted by Government, thus, it is not covered by clause (vi) of serial no. 3 of Notification - Whether therefore, service supplied by applicant to NCBS is not taxable at concessional rate of 12 per cent and is taxable at 18 per cent under residual item no. (xii) of Serial No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017- Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017 - Held, yes [Paras 5 and 6]GST: Works contract service provided by applicant to National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS) for construction of hostel building on campus is taxable at 18 per cent GST under residual item no. (xii) of Serial No. 3 of Notification No. 11/2017- Central Tax (Rate) dated 28-6-2017

Hotel -cum-shopping and multiplex construction - Construction Services - Heading No. 9954 - Classification - Applicant intends to get a land from WBHIDCO on 99 years lease for purpose of setting up of hotel-cum-shopping and multiplex which includes permission to construct certain area as residential flats - According to Draft Lease Deed as per tender, lessee is not permitted to sub-lease land or part thereof - However, applicant, being lessee, will be permitted to sub-lease/ assign right on constructed area - It is obvious that ownership of land remains with WBHIDCO - Applicant may sub-lease/assign rights of constructed area in following two models (a) one-time lump sum payment (may be payable in installments till completion and granting possession and registry in favour of prospective clients) for constructed units, (b) against periodic payments for use constructed area, during term of agreement, without any registry with Registrar and on expiry constructed area shall be repossessed by lessee i.e. applicant - HELD: Applicable SAC Code on this supply is 9954 as Construction Services) and applicable tax rate on supply under consideration shall be 18% - Applicant is eligible for a deduction as attributable to land portion i.e. 1/3 of consideration on total value of supply for purpose of payment of applicable tax - GST is to be paid on construction work for prospective clients, regardless of whether a lump sum or periodic payments, is charged [Section  9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/ West Bengal Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 3.9, 3.10, 3.11 and 3.12] [In favour of Revenue] Hotel -cum-shopping and multiplex - Accomodation Service - Heading 9963 - Exemption - Applicant intends to get a land from WBHIDCO on 99 years lease for purpose of setting up of hotel-cum-shopping and multiplex which includes permission to construct certain area as residential flats - According to Draft Lease Deed as per tender, lessee is not permitted to sub-lease land or part thereof - However, applicant, being lessee, will be permitted to sub-lease/ assign right on constructed area - It is obvious that ownership of land remains with WBHIDCO - Applicant may sub-lease/assign rights of constructed area in following two models (a) one-time lump sum payment (may be payable in installments till completion and granting possession and registry in favour of prospective clients) for constructed units, (b) against periodic payments for use constructed area, during term of agreement, without any registry with Registrar and on expiry constructed area shall be repossessed by lessee i.e. applicant - HELD: - It will not fall under Accommodation Service under SAC Code 9963 and, hence, question of exemption under entry in sl. No. 12 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated June 28, 2017 does not arise [Section  11 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/ West Bengal Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 3.12] [In favour of Revenue] Hotel - Membership Organization Services - Heading No. 9995 - Classification - Applicant intends to get a land from WBHIDCO on 99 years lease for purpose of setting up of hotel-cum-shopping and multiplex which includes permission to construct certain area as residential flats - According to Draft Lease Deed as per tender, lessee is not permitted to sub-lease land or part thereof - However, applicant, being lessee, will be permitted to sub-lease/ assign right on constructed area - It is obvious that ownership of land remains with WBHIDCO - Applicant may sub-lease/assign rights of constructed area in following two models (a) one-time lump sum payment (may be payable in installments till completion and granting possession and registry in favour of prospective clients) for constructed units, (b) against periodic payments for use constructed area, during term of agreement, without any registry with Registrar and on expiry constructed area shall be repossessed by lessee i.e. applicant - Besides above arrangement, prospective customers may also be required to pay monthly/annual maintenance charges either directly toapplicant or to some society made for same - HELD: GST is payable on monthly/annual maintenance charges as per entry in sl. no. 33 of Notification No. 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated June 28, 2017 - SAC Code in this case would be 9995 and the applicable GST rate is 18% [Section  9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/ West Bengal Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017] [Para 3.12] [In favour of revenue]   Circulars and Notifications: Notification No. 11/2017 dated 28-6-2017, Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated June 28, 2017

Classification of services - Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Civil Construction and works contract services - Heading No. 9954 (Construction services)/Section 2(119) of the Central Goods And Services Tax Act, 2017/Section 2(119) of the Karnataka Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 - Works contract - Applicant is engaged in business of Civil Construction and Works Contract Services - It has entered into agreement to undertake subcontract work of civil construction of residential complexes/row of residential houses which in turn has been allotted to GIPL (main contractor) through tender by Bengaluru Development Authority - Whether since projects of applicant are involving supply of both goods and services and is in relation to an immovable property it is a 'work contract' within meaning of section 2(119) - Held, yes - Whether works contract is for construction of a civil structure and since it is a residential real estate project, works is predominantly for use other than commerce, industry or any other business or profession and it is covered under clause (a) of entry 3(vi) of Notification No.11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017 - Held, yes - Whether further, since main contractor is providing services specified in item 3(vi) of Notification No.11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, subcontract work of works contract provided by applicant as a subcontractor to main contractor is covered under item (ix) of entry 3 of Notification No.11/2017 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017, as amended by Notification No. 1/2018 - Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018, taxable at 6 per cent CGST with effect from 25-1-2018 - Whether however, for period from 1-7-2017 to 24-1-2018, same is taxable at 9 per cent CGST - Held, yes [Paras 11 and 12]GST: Projects of applicant involving work orders from Principal contractor for civil construction of residential complexes consisting of supply of both goods and services in relation to an immovable property is a 'works contract' within meaning of section 2(119)   GST: Bangalore Development Authority is a Government Entity within meaning of Notification No.11/2017-Central Tax (Rate), dated 28-6-2017

Construction of Commercial apartments - Tax Liabilityon supply of construction of a complex, building civil structure or a part thereof, including, commercial apartments -Applicant is engaged in supplying services of construction, erection, commissioning, installation, completion, fitting out, repair, maintenance, renovation or alteration of affordable and other than affordable residential apartments, non-affordable housing and commercial apartments under Real Estate project (REP) - Applicant seeks advance ruling on applicable GST Rate on supply of construction of a complex, building civil structure or a part thereof, including, commercial apartments (shops, offices, godowns etc) by a promoter in a REP other than RREP - Held:In instant case, it is clear that services provided by taxpayer clearly falls under notification No. 03/2019- CT (rate) dated 29.03.2019 - Therefore , applicant is liable to pay GST at rate of 18% [9% - CGST + 9% - SGST] in respect of services of construction of complex, building, civil structure or a part including commercial apartments (shops, offices, godowns etc.) as per entry at Item No. (if) of Notification No. 03/2019-Central Tax (Rate), dated 29.03.2019, subject to conditions prescribed under said entry. [Section 9 of Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017/Rajasthan Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017][Para 11][In favour of assessee]

facts.text:
The applicant has entered into civil construction contract with 'J' Ltd. in respect of seven residential buildings.

The applicant seeks advance ruling on question as to whether the construction services proposed to be provided by the applicant under the subject project will qualify for the reduced GST rate of 12 per cent (6 per cent each of CGST & SGST), as provided in Sl. No. 3, item (v), sub-item (da) of Notification No. 1/2018-Central Tax (Rate), dated 25-1-2018.

The applicant is engaged in works contract relating to execution of large-scale infrastructure projects, like Airports, Defence Industrial/ Technical Buildings, Hospitals, Housing, Steel Structural, Highways, and Bridges. It has been awarded a project by the Airport Authority of India and the contract allotted is in the nature of works contract. The scope of the project is development and upgradation of Airports by construction or extension of Runway, construction of new Taxi track, Apron, Isolation bay, Perimeter road and other allied works.

The applicant has sought advance ruling in respect of applicable rate of tax on works allotted by the Airport Authority of India:

(i)

Development of Airport by construction of Runway, Taxi track, Apron, Isolation bay, Perimeter Road including Earthwork and other allied works.

(ii)

Upgradation of Airport to make it suitable for operation of any type of aircraft by extension of Runway, Construction of New Apron, Taxi track, Isolation bay including Link taxi, GSE area, Perimeter road, and allied works (Civil & Electrical).

The applicant (M.P. Power Generating Co. Ltd.) is 100 per cent Madhya Pradesh State Government hold company.

The State Government of Madhya Pradesh awarded a contract to the applicant to construct a Thermal Power Project.

Further the applicant has awarded a contract to one Shreeji Infrastructure India (P.) Ltd. towards construction of certain residential quarters at aforesaid Thermal Power Project.

It sought advance ruling on the following questions:

-

Rate of GST on contract for construction of building and structure for colony at Thermal Power Project as per Notification No. 11/2017 as amended by Notification No. 24/2017 and further amended vide Notification No. 31/2017.

-

Rate of GST on construction contract of residential quarters at various power houses of the applicant as per Notification No. 11/2017 as amended by Notification No. 24/2017 and further amended vide Notification No. 31/2017.

The applicant submitted before the Authority for Advance Ruling that Shreeji Infrastructure India (P.)
